changes: Fixed a data-loss bug where a partial profile update could overwrite unrelated fields, so your cash, mines and progress are always preserved!
Insert retries now tolerate more database error codes, so new accounts and concurrent saves no longer fail spuriously.
Full-table scans are now paginated, keeping Idle Miner Bot snappy and memory-light as more miners join.
Prestige now correctly scales mine production again - rebuilding after a prestige uses the right factor!
Barrier unlocks now use per-barrier tier gates, so every barrier checks the shafts it actually needs.
Shop and settings buttons now use opaque IDs with ownership checks - only you can press your own buttons.
Activity tracking is throttled and off the command path, so commands respond faster.
All money maths now uses overflow-safe helpers, so late-game balances always add up.
Aligned the infrastructure with VivacityAPI and introduced a shared command layer so prefix and slash commands run the same implementation.
Normalized gameplay data keys and added player profiles.
Removed a committed service-account credential from the repository.
Added the settings command for alerts, number formatting and premium idle-time preferences.
Added richer idle-cash overviews and improved manager hiring and overview flows.
Hardened runtime scheduling and startup validation, and added sanity checks for command loading.
Reduced database costs.
Added global error handling so unexpected errors no longer crash the bot.
Major data-layer rework with a new database manager and leaderboard.
Improved work and upgrade flows.
Added premium content and boosters.
Bot release! Idle Miner Tycoon in your Discord chat with mines, shafts, elevators, warehouses, managers and barriers.
